title: @streetraceing/package configuration
description: Strict JSON configuration for the @streetraceing/package CLI. Store this object in .packagerc or .packagerc.json.

$schema.description: Enables editor completion and validation for .packagerc.

root.description: Project root, resolved relative to the directory containing the configuration file.

output.description: Output directory, resolved relative to the project root.

name.description: Default archive filename. The {folder} token is replaced with the project root folder name.

strategy.description: File collection strategy. The git strategy uses git ls-files when possible and falls back to the internal walker.

gitignore.description: Respect .gitignore rules and standard Git exclusions.

npmignore.description: Also apply .npmignore rules while collecting files.

include.description: Glob patterns that select files eligible for packaging.

ignore.description: Additional glob patterns to exclude after standard ignore processing.

dot.description: Include dotfiles such as .github and .npmrc unless another rule excludes them.

followSymlinks.description: Follow symbolic links while walking the project. Disabled by default for safety.

includeEmptyDirectories.description: Include empty directory entries in generated archives.

manifest.description: Write .packagemanifest.json with file metadata and SHA-256 hashes.

shiftFile.description: Project-relative PackageShift source file. When present, package zip validates it and stores it as the reserved .packageshift archive entry.

compressionLevel.description: ZIP deflate compression level. Use 0 to store files without compression.

deterministic.description: Use stable ordering and normalized metadata to produce reproducible archives.

preserveMode.description: Preserve Unix file permission modes in the archive manifest.

preserveMtime.description: Preserve source modification times instead of normalized deterministic timestamps.

sensitiveFiles.description: Behavior when potentially sensitive files such as .env or private keys are selected.

backupOnApply.description: Create a rollback archive in .package-backups before applying changes.

conflictStrategy.description: Default behavior when local files conflict with an update package.

renameDetection.description: Detect exact renames by matching hashes while creating shift archives.

renameThreshold.description: Reserved similarity threshold for approximate rename detection.
